coverage: all rank-eligible races; no confidence selection, no extra picks, one winner/ordered triple/unordered triple per race
selection_rule: candidate must not reduce any of the three exact hit rates versus incumbent on selection races; then maximize product of target-normalized hit rates, then lower joint target NLL, then name; incumbent fallback
unordered_decision: maximum sum of the six ordered joint probabilities for exactly three distinct horses
evaluation_role: already inspected exploratory retrospective; never unseen or forward
missing_data: preserve isolated unlinked rows and masked current going/weight; no inferred IDs or timestamps
forbidden: no odds, payouts, EV, result-time input features, changes to 2025/2026 conditions after results
promotion: no automatic live model replacement; keep all rejected candidates in selection table
